biotools.summary: CRESSENT is a modular bioinformatic pipeline designed for the systematic exploration and annotation of ssDNA viruses. It processes metagenomic data through modules including decontamination, phylogenetic analysis, motif discovery, and structure prediction.
biotools.name: CRESSENT
